caption:
Camembert Rôti aux Pêches & Jambon cru

Ingrédients :
Camembert
Pêches 🍑
Jambon cru
Noix
Miel 🍯

📌 Recette :
• Laissez le camembert à température ambiante 20 min avant la cuisson.
• Coupez les pêches en morceaux. 🍑
• Déposez le camembert dans un plat, ajoutez les pêches, le jambon cru, les noix et un filet de miel. 🍯
• Enfournez à 190°C / 380°F pendant 15–20 min.

Astuce : Le camembert au lait cru est idéal pour obtenir un cœur bien fondant.

Bon appétit ❤️

title: Honey Baked Camembert with Peaches & Prosciutto
one_liner: Melted camembert baked with fresh peaches, prosciutto, walnuts, and honey for an easy appetizer.
key_points: Rest camembert at room temperature 20 minutes before baking for even melting
Top with sliced peaches, prosciutto, walnuts, and a drizzle of honey
Bake at 190°C / 380°F for 15–20 minutes until gooey
Use raw-milk camembert for the best molten center

instructions: 1. Remove camembert from fridge and let rest at room temperature for 20 minutes.
3. Place camembert in a baking dish and top with peach slices, prosciutto, walnuts, and a drizzle of honey.
4. Bake at 190°C / 380°F for 15–20 minutes until the cheese is fully melted and golden.
5. Serve immediately with bread or crackers.
